answer: Smart-meter binding ties each agent to one real household's power feed. First, the operator authorizes a Green Button data share from their utility; the ledger rejects meters under a year old or already linked. Second, each epoch posts a random pattern, say four 10-minute bursts of a 2 kW kettle. Third, the 15-minute readings must show that spiral of spikes within 24 hours. A grower drying yarrow under lamps passes easily. Faking 300 agents means 300 leases at $900 a month, held a year first: $3.2 million. It's a vine rooted in soil: it can't climb a wall it was never planted beside.
